name: Great Mountain Zen Center
technique: Zazen (shikantaza and koan practice), chanting, dokusan, samu (work practice)
teacherAccess: Private dokusan (interview) with Roshi Shishin Wick, Roshi Shinko Perez, or resident teachers/priests is available during sesshins and by arrangement during personal or residential stays.
retreatOptions: Weekend and 5-day silent sesshins (hybrid) several times a year, plus self-directed personal retreats of a weekend, week, or month, and short- or long-term residential Zen training.
about: Great Mountain Zen Center, based at Maitreya Abbey on a rural property south of Berthoud, Colorado, is a Zen Buddhist training and retreat center in the White Plum Asanga lineage of Taizan Maezumi Roshi. Founded in 1996 by Gerry Shishin Wick, Roshi, and co-led with Roshi Ilia Shinko Perez, the abbey pairs a small residential monastic community with a lay sangha that gathers for weekly meditation, classes, and hybrid in-person/virtual retreats. GMZC hosts weekend and five-day silent sesshins throughout the year, including a Summer Sesshin and a December Rohatsu Sesshin, built around long blocks of zazen, chanting, dharma talks, work practice (samu), and optional private interviews (dokusan) with the teachers. Beyond scheduled sesshins, the abbey offers self-directed personal retreats and short- or long-term residential Zen training for practitioners wanting extended solitary or communal practice time on site. The center operates on a suggested-donation model, and guests on personal retreat are asked to bring and prepare their own food given limited kitchen and refrigerator space.
schedule: Weekend sesshins in Feb, Mar, Apr, Sep, and Oct; a 5-day Summer Sesshin in late May; a 5-day Rohatsu Sesshin in early December; personal and residential stays are scheduled individually by arrangement.
cost: Suggested-donation model: sesshin participation runs roughly $70-85/day depending on attendance type, while self-directed personal residential retreats are $50/day (private room) for stays under a week, discounted to about $225/week or $750/month for longer stays.

pricePerDay.notes: Derived from personal-retreat private-room suggested donations on the Residential Stays page: $50/day for stays under 7 days, ~$32/day equivalent for week-long stays ($225/week), and ~$25/day equivalent for month-long stays ($750/month). Food is not included.

foodNotes: Sesshins include a provided vegetarian lunch and tea for in-person attendees; guests on self-directed personal retreats or residential stays are self-catered, with limited fridge/cabinet space for their own food.
workNotes: Sesshins include samu (work practice); residents have assigned weekly chores and duties; guests on personal retreat are not required to work but may attend group activities.
